content:
julia: Heads-up - ACME just sent back the security questionnaire and flagged a few blockers. They want written answers + an evidence bundle by EOD Wed. Main asks: RBAC mappings for tenant admins, audit log retention/export proof, KMS key custody (HSM) + rotation proof, and how we handle vuln triage/incident evidence chain. Can we triage and call tomorrow?

sam: I can take the logs/KMS bits. For RBAC mapping we need product input (maria). I'll draft export steps and sample policies.

maria: On RBAC: customers want to map their SAML groups to tenant roles and see the mapping table. We currently support group->role mapping via SCIM/SAML assertions; need to confirm exact attribute names ACME expects. Sample mapping: customer:acme-admins -> tenant:admin, customer:acme-auditors -> tenant:read-only.

kevin: For audit logs: we ship structured audit events to our internal kafka and then to s3 with lifecycle rules. We can provide signed manifests + SHA256 checksums for a given export window. Retention default is 365d for enterprise, can set to 90d for others.

sam: Quick sample of the export CLI we can include in the evidence bundle:
```
redwood-log-export 
  --source audit-stream 
  --start 2024-11-01T00:00:00Z 
  --end   2024-11-30T23:59:59Z 
  --dest   s3://redwood-evidence/acme/2024-11 
  --compress gz 
  --kms-key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01
```
Note: the export above is envelope-encrypted with the provided KMS key. We can include the signed manifest and the key ARN used.

julia: ACME is specifically asking about HSM-backed keys and whether keys are exportable. We should be explicit: we use cloud KMS (AWS KMS + CloudHSM optional) and keys are non-exportable when created in HSM. We need to confirm private deployments run HSM or KMS.

maria: For RBAC evidence I'll pull the mapping table + SAML assertion debug traces (sanitized) and a short doc describing roles/privileges. Also will include sample SCIM patch payloads.

kevin: On vuln triage: the runtime CVE they quoted (CVE-2025-XXXX) is labeled medium by NVD. Patch is scheduled; mitigation is a config flag that disables legacy code path. We should provide: CVE summary, affected versions, mitigation steps, current deploy status (patched in prod on 2024-12-02), and the Jira link.

julia: For incident evidence chain (legal asks): ACME wants chain-of-custody for exported logs + tamper-evidence. We can provide signed manifests with per-file SHA256 and a timestamped signature from sec-bot (our signing key). We also keep audit entries for export operations (who triggered export, from which IP, the job id).

sec-bot: EXPORT_EVENT id=export-20241130-7f4a triggered_by=julia on=2024-11-30T14:12:03Z dest=s3://redwood-evidence/acme/2024-11 manifest_sha256=3a7b...

sam: Action items I can own: create a short "how we export" README + redwood-log-export sample + signed manifest example (include fake hashes) by EOD tomorrow.

maria: I'll produce RBAC mapping table + sanitized SAML trace + SCIM examples by tomorrow noon.

kevin: I'll pull the vuln triage packet, patch timeline, and the incident export audit entries and attach.

nate-oncall: If we need a 30-60m call with ACME, I can join as oncall and walk through IR/forensics details. I have availability Wed 09:00-11:00 PT.

julia: Let's propose Wed 10:00 PT. I'll send calendar invite and the preliminary evidence bundle link once sam uploads. Also: ping legal for any redaction guidance.

sam: Putting draft export README here: https://redwood.internal/docs/evidence/export-readme-draft (will replace with signed bundle link). :thumbsup:

maria: Also suggest adding a one-page infographic for ACME that shows: RBAC mapping -> log flow -> key custody -> evidence chain. That helps non-technical auditors.

julia: Agreed. Thanks all - will collect artifacts and run through them before the call. If anyone finds PII in traces, flag me and redact.

kevin: FYI, I noticed one audit export job had a delayed upload (S3 503 retry). I will include retry logs and an explanation (transient, retried 5x, successful at 14:15Z).

julia: Perfect. Last ask from ACME: can we include a sample SLA clause wording for log retention and key custody? I can draft and then pass to legal.

nate-oncall: Added to calendar invite. See you Wed 10:00 PT. :calendar:
